newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK ETANE SETS IPO PRICE, PERIOD JUNE 2-4.
newsitem.headline: GREEK ETANE SETS IPO PRICE, PERIOD JUNE 2-4.

text.p: Greek construction firm Etane SA set its IPO price at 1,850 drachmas a share and the subscription period from June 2 to June 4, it said in a statement.

Etane will be listed on the Athens bourse's small-cap parallel market issuing 400,000 common registered shares with a par value of 100 drachmas and a 20,000 tranche which will be privately placed, at 1,850 drachmas each.

Lead underwriter and advisor to the issue is Telesis Securities, with NIBID , Piraeus Bank , Xiosbank, Societe Generale-Athens, Ionian Bank , Egnatia Bank, European Popular Bank and Sarros Securities acting as co-underwriters to the issue, it said.
Etane specialises in prefabricated construction, renovation and rehabilitation of landmark buildings and is a member of Europe's 500 --an association of fast growing European companies.
Its after-tax profits rose 65.4 percent to 0.402 billion drachmas in fiscal 1996 on turnover growth of 28.5 percent to 2.294 billion.
The company will use IPO proceeds, 0.777 billion drachmas, to finance equipment acquisition, boost working capital and retire debt. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
